title: 2018 LLVM Developers’ Meeting:  C. Schafmeister “Lessons Learned Implementing Common Lisp with LLVM”
summary: Christian Schafmeister presents lessons from six years of implementing Clasp, a Common Lisp compiler using LLVM as its backend that interoperates with C++. He explains handling a dynamic, memory-managed language on LLVM.
why: Mostly cited by the author himself as the introduction to Clasp and Cando, and recommended to those wanting Lisp with C++ library interop.

quote.text: those interested in this use case might also be interested in Clasp, a Common Lisp implementation built on LLVM
